items.title: cline/cline Desktop v0.0.27
items.snippet: - An expired Cline sign-in now produces one actionable error instead of two dead ends. A turn that fails before the runtime takes the prompt was reported twice — the hub's detail-less `run.failed` appended a bubble, then the send RPC resolved with the real error and overwrote the error banner underneath it — so you got a vague bubble stacked on a detailed banner.
